blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu Province residents can now apply online for the provincial government’s Right to Care Program, which allows eligible individuals to formally designate a care partner to accompany them in hospitals, participate in authorized discussions about their treatment, and help them access social welfare support.
